title: Technology executive to lead KU assessment technology center with national reach
summary_en: Scott McLewin joins Assessment & Technology Solutions (ATS) at the University of Kansas after more than a decade in leadership roles for a financial technology company, most recently as chief technology officer.
title_cn: Technology executive to lead KU assessment technology center with national reach

title: KU students honor speech-language-hearing lecturer with 2026 HOPE Award
summary_en: At the Oct. 24 Homecoming football game, Courtney Summers received the award, which remains the only honor given to faculty through the Student Alumni and Endowment Board.
title_cn: KU students honor speech-language-hearing lecturer with 2026 HOPE Award

title: Connected by nanotech: KU researcher leads $4 million, multistate NSF grant to decode diseases
summary_en: Foundation Distinguished Professor Steve Soper is leading a team of researchers who are developing nanotechnology that can identify diseases and health anomalies by analyzing the structure of proteins involved in the disease down to the individual amino acid level. This approach could change how doctors detect, monitor and treat complex diseases, such as the many forms of cancer.
title_cn: Connected by nanotech: KU researcher leads $4 million, multistate NSF grant to decode diseases

title: Students lead community-minded service projects through KU Trailblazers Program
summary_en: Eighteen Jayhawks are leading service projects in partnership with community and campus partners as part of the Center for Service Learning's Trailblazers Mini-Grant program. Throughout the academic year, students connect monthly for cohort training and group problem-solving.
title_cn: Students lead community-minded service projects through KU Trailblazers Program

title: Researchers land grant to test effectiveness, sustainability of fitness program for individuals with disabilities
summary_en: Researchers in the Life Span Institute at the University of Kansas will evaluate a community fitness program that has been adapted for individuals with mobility disabilities. The program will set up a randomized control trial to see if Functional Fitness is more effective at long-term use, improving mobility, strength and other factors.
title_cn: Researchers land grant to test effectiveness, sustainability of fitness program for individuals with disabilities
